UPDATE transcript_runs
SET status = 'failed',
    error = {{ JSON.stringify($('Format Crash Failure').item.json.step + ': ' + $('Format Crash Failure').item.json.raw) }},
    finished_at = NOW()
WHERE n8n_execution_id = '{{ $('Format Crash Failure').item.json.executionId }}'
  AND status = 'running'
RETURNING id;
